I took my toy poodle, Bianca, to the AniCura Laterza Veterinary Clinic for a checkup, and my experience was excellent in every way.
​A special thank you goes to Dr. Marzocchella for the meticulous and thorough cardiology exam, and to the dear Dr. Ambrosino, whom we have known for years and whose constant presence always brings us great comfort and reassurance. Both demonstrated extraordinary professionalism, combined with a rare kindness and sensitivity with Bianca, who was pampered and immediately felt at ease.
​The entire staff was welcoming and punctual, and the facility is clean, modern, and well-organized. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for their dedication and sincere attention to detail. Highly recommended clinic!
They are doctors with a big heart, Dr. Annetta and Dr. Marzocchella who treated my puppies are true professionals and then they treat you as if you were their friend forever.
It's important to feel like you're in the right place when circumstances make you feel fragile and uncertain about the path to take.

I brought my cat to this clinic in very serious condition, and we were taken care of promptly, without any waiting, from the secretaries to the front desk and Dr. Alberta Vincenzo.
All the necessary tests and checks were performed immediately, and my cat remained hospitalized for a week, until he was finally able to go home today.
I found it to be a truly excellent clinic, not only for the professionalism and expertise of the entire team, but above all for the empathy, kindness, and attention shown during such a difficult time. Knowing that Travis was in safe hands really made a difference. I've read some negative reviews about the prices, but from my experience, I can say that they are absolutely in line with, if not lower than, many other clinics, and above all, they only perform truly necessary tests and checks.
Regarding waiting times, having frequented the clinic almost every day, I've seen firsthand how many emergencies and urgencies they handle on a daily basis. Sometimes I had to wait, but I understood the situation, because behind the wait there was probably an animal that needed immediate care. My cat's situation remains delicate, and the cause is not easy to treat. I still don't know how it will go, but I am immensely happy to have been able to save him and finally bring him home.
Thank you so much to the entire team for what you did for him. ❤️

My cat, Figaro, had to undergo a very delicate operation to remove a 15x20 cm hepatic cyst. The surgery was performed by Dr. Maurizio Saccone, who carried out this delicate procedure with great professionalism and compassion. A few days after the surgery, the cat made a full recovery. I sincerely thank Dr. Saccone and his staff for the excellent outcome of the surgery. However, I must point out a flaw in the Laterza Veterinary Clinic's structure: it is impossible to contact them by phone. The clinic is equipped with an automatic answering system, "ANGIE," which takes calls but rarely gets a return call, even in urgent cases.
Highly qualified and empathetic staff. Dr. Marzocco is a guarantee, a professional and exceptional human being.

Hi Adele,
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review about our clinic.
The well-being of our patients and the satisfaction of our clients are our motivation!
See you soon!
I called this morning for an emergency, they didn't answer and I don't express what you are
In the emergency room in the middle of August, I handed my four-month-old dog over to the doctor on duty. He was excellent, empathetic, kind, and incredibly competent. He practically saved her.

An extremely disappointing experience, especially due to the complete lack of organization.

I had an appointment scheduled for 11:00 a.m. and was seen almost at 1:00 p.m. I completely understand that a facility that also handles emergencies might experience delays, especially when pets require immediate care. The problem, however, is precisely the lack of clear management between emergencies and scheduled appointments.

If the facility is unable to simultaneously manage the emergency room and appointments, it should organize its flow better: have doctors dedicated to emergencies, others to scheduled appointments, or clearly inform clients when appointments can no longer be guaranteed. Leaving people and pets waiting for hours without any real management of order and priorities only creates chaos.

The environment also seemed unsuitable to me, especially for cats: a waiting room full of barking dogs, with no separation or management to reduce the animals' stress. Fortunately, my cat is very calm, but not all cats react the same way.

I'm not criticizing the fact that real emergencies are given priority: that's absolutely correct. I am criticizing the lack of organization, communication, and management that makes the entire experience chaotic and unprofessional. Personally, I won't be returning.

Unfortunately, this was a negative experience, which we share with the hope that it can be a starting point for improvement. We contacted the Laterza Veterinary Clinic on August 2nd for our cat Carolina, who had been experiencing fatigue and a loss of appetite for several days. After several tests, she was admitted following an ultrasound that revealed liver inflammation and a modest amount of abdominal fluid. We were also informed that FIP ​​was suspected and that we would need to wait for a PCR test. Initially, we were told Thursday morning was the expected time for the results and, consequently, the time for discharge. Our main difficulty was communication and continuity of management. The promised updates did not arrive as regularly as we expected, and, by working with different veterinarians, we sometimes found ourselves faced with conflicting indications and assessments: what one doctor told us at one point seemed at odds with what another professional later communicated. Managing the PCR test was particularly problematic. On Thursday morning, when we were expecting the results and her discharge, we were informed that the test wouldn't arrive until the following week and that, in the veterinarians' opinion, it would be preferable to keep Carolina hospitalized. This would have meant additional hospital stays and therefore additional costs. Only then did we learn that, in reality, the PCR had never been sent, because FIP had already been ruled out as a diagnostic possibility in the previous few days. We therefore wished to be informed promptly of this change, especially considering that hospitalization had initially been planned while awaiting that test.
We would also have liked greater transparency on the financial front. The estimated hospitalization cost was €606, while the final cost was higher. We also learned later that a test for hemobartonellosis had been performed, costing €100, which we don't recall having been informed of in advance.
Some aspects of her hospital stay also left us perplexed: upon discharge, Carolina was soiled with feces, and we noticed a cockroach in an area adjacent to the ward. Our report didn't seem to have been handled as we expected.
In hindsight, we wondered if it might not have been possible to proceed more gradually, initially assessing the response to a simpler treatment before further tests and hospital stay. We are not qualified to judge medical decisions, and we don't intend to conclude that they were necessarily incorrect. However, once discharged, Carolina began treatment with antibiotics and anti-inflammatory drugs, which we had been advised not to begin earlier, and over the next five days, she showed marked improvement and recovered. In the end, we left without a definitive diagnosis, after four days of hospitalization and with a total cost of approximately €800, a significant amount for us. We don't dispute the complexity of the case or the need for further tests: we simply would have liked greater clarity, communication, continuity, and transparency regarding costs and clinical decisions. This is our personal experience. Unfortunately, we were deeply disappointed and, based on what we experienced, we cannot recommend the property.

We took our dog there twice for orthopedic surgeries. We had a great experience with Dr. Saccone, who was very professional, extremely helpful, and extremely caring. He immediately gave us a sense of security and peace of mind, even knowing the surgery was very delicate. Fortunately, the surgeries went great!

The management definitely needs improvement.
The wait times are incredibly long, with multiple appointments often occurring at the same time. There's certainly not enough staff to handle all this.
This aspect could definitely be improved, as well as the secretaries; some are truly unprofessional, unhelpful, and very rude!

Very clean and organized clinic. I operated on my American Bully at TPLO as soon as he left the clinic. He was much better after two months. I can say that my dog ​​is back to life. Many thanks to everyone, especially to Dr. Saccone, a very polite, respectful and always available person who with his golden hands saved my dog. I recommend him to everyone. They don't do it just for work, but for the love of animals. Thanks again from Masaniello.

5 stars for the doctors, both male and female, and the staff who treat our four-legged friends. They saved our cat from a very critical situation.

1 star for the receptionist, who lacks empathy and is full of arrogance. Anyone who isn't happy doing their job and does it only for the paycheck should stay home.

You pay a little more than other clinics, but for the quality of the services received, I'd say the value for money is 100/100.
I brought a stray kitten to the emergency room and they took care of him promptly and professionally. Let's hope he gets through it. I'll know the outcome tomorrow.

Just two words to describe them: VENAL - CYNICAL. You can't take in a stray cat, pretend to care for it, and only after asking for and receiving the sum of €180 say "HE DIED LAST NIGHT." They are heartless, profiting from the pain of those who truly love and want to save animals, whether they are owners or strays, without distinction.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We're so happy you had a positive experience. We appreciate your trust and are always available to take care of your four-legged friends.

Thank you so much for giving us 5 stars! We're delighted that your experience at our clinic was positive. We appreciate your trust and hope to continue caring for your four-legged friends with the same attention and professionalism.

Best regards from the entire team at the Laterza Veterinary Clinic in Naples

At the Laterza Veterinary Clinic in Naples, during my dog ​​Florence's specialist visit, I found the staff to be friendly, competent, and welcoming. All aspects of the diagnosis and treatment were clearly explained to me, which gave me reassurance about my pet's health.

I would like to sincerely thank the entire team at Clinica Laterza for saving, once again, my French bulldog, Brenda.

When we faced a second hernia and subsequent paralysis, we were very concerned. From the very beginning, however, we found the staff to be well-prepared, helpful, and deeply compassionate. Doctors, nurses, and the anesthesiologist instilled confidence and serenity in us, clearly explaining every step of the process.

The surgery was a complete success, and Brenda was cared for with great care both during the procedure and in the post-operative period, which this time was longer and more delicate than the first. Seeing her walk again and slowly resume her life was an immense emotion.

A special thanks goes to Dr. Pollina, who demonstrated not only great expertise but also a rare willingness to help: the very evening of the surgery, he personally called us, late at night, to explain in detail how the operation had gone and to reassure us about her clinical condition. It's a gesture we'll never forget and speaks volumes about her professionalism and dedication.

My sincere thanks to the entire Laterza Clinic for their professionalism, kindness, and attentiveness. I recommend this facility to anyone facing an emergency or a delicate procedure: from the receptionist to the inpatient ward, everyone we met was competent, helpful, and driven by a sincere love for animals.

For us, the La Terza Veterinary Clinic means life to our dog Azzurra. It has given us the opportunity to meet veterinarians with a capital "V," who, in addition to doing their work excellently, have demonstrated and continue to demonstrate boundless love for all their patients. We have known these magnificent people firsthand for almost eight years now. We are primarily treated by Dr. Laura Marzocco, the one who saved our dog Azzurra from spinal dysplasia. She did everything she could to ensure that Azzurra was a happy and healthy dog, and now, years later, we can say this even more. At the La Terza Veterinary Clinic, we have met a team of extraordinary doctors who, in addition to walking alongside us for Azzurra's routine check-ups, have also proven to be a fabulous team for surgical procedures. I say this because Azzurra recently underwent surgery with serenity and confidence. Seeing them all together explaining and reassuring us about the surgery, given Azzurra's illnesses in previous years. They reassured us in a professional and humane manner about the pros and cons of the procedure, clearly and precisely but without ever causing us unnecessary anxiety or worry.
I conclude by saying that I recommend the La Terza Veterinary Clinic with my eyes closed.

It was Clicquot's first visit to the AniCura Laterza clinic, and it was a delightful discovery. I've visited many clinics in the past, but none had ever found the right "cure" for Clicquot's chronic kidney disease. I'd like to highlight the skill and empathy of Dr. Marzocco, who was truly wonderful with him. Just three days after treatment, he seems to be doing much better. Thank you so much. <3

I'd like to leave a review especially for Dr. Marianna Marzocchella, a professional I consider truly exceptional. In all the years I've trusted her, I've always found her extremely helpful, competent, and knowledgeable. She manages to combine great professionalism with genuine care for animals and their owners, explaining every situation clearly and always instilling trust. She's a veterinarian who carries out her work with passion and dedication, and she undoubtedly represents one of the facility's main strengths.
Regarding the clinic, I find it to be an excellent facility, well-organized from a healthcare perspective, modern and well-equipped, with qualified staff and high-quality services. Unfortunately, however, there's one aspect that has significantly worsened recently: bookings. I fully understand that there are so many requests and that managing a large number of patients is not easy, but booking an appointment has become truly complicated. Furthermore, the introduction of the intelligent voice assistant, at least in my experience, hasn't improved the situation; on the contrary, it's made contact even more difficult and less immediate. It would be desirable to find a more effective solution, because a service of this level also deserves a worthy booking system.
In conclusion, I will continue to choose this clinic primarily because of Dr. Marzocchella, an extraordinary professional who deserves every praise. I only hope the appointment management issue is resolved as soon as possible, because it's really the only aspect currently penalizing an otherwise excellent service.

There are people who do their job with skill and people who, beyond that, put their heart into it. Dr. Giuseppe Palazzo is one of those people you never forget.
We had to face the most painful moment an animal lover can experience: saying goodbye to our beloved Stellina. A pain that seemed unbearable. Yet, in the midst of so much suffering, we found a doctor who gave us something precious: time, respect, and humanity.
The doctor never pressured us into a choice. He left us free to decide, he gave us time to listen to our hearts and to fully experience every last moment with our Stellina. He remained at our side with infinite kindness, comforting us with words we will never forget and making us feel understood in our pain.
But the love he showed us wasn't just for us. Stellina was also welcomed with sweetness, cuddled, and treated with a tenderness that filled our hearts. Knowing that her final moments were lived with serenity, respect, and love is an immense gift that we will always carry with us.
In a world where we often rush and forget the value of empathy, Dr. Giuseppe Palazzo reminded us what it truly means to be a doctor: caring not only for animals, but also for the people who love them.
Thank you, Doctor, for accompanying us with such compassion on the most difficult day of our lives. You not only cared for our Stellina, but also for a part of our hearts. We need many more veterinarians like you. We will be forever grateful.
Positive experience
Competent doctors and so much love for animals.

An extremely positive experience. I took my dog ​​for othematoma surgery and we were treated by Dr. Francesco Annetta. From the very beginning, we found the staff to be extremely professional, helpful, and attentive to our pet. The surgery went very well, and the post-op recovery was handled with care and expertise. All the clinic staff were kind, welcoming, and always available to answer any questions. I highly recommend this facility to anyone looking for knowledgeable veterinarians who truly care about animal welfare.

I would like to sincerely thank the entire clinic for their hospitality, professionalism, and above all, the humanity I encountered.
After months of worrying about my cat Esme, the doctor was extremely attentive, patient, and thorough: he listened with great sensitivity to her entire story, examining her delicately and without wanting to further stress or traumatize her unnecessarily. I finally felt listened to and understood. And above all, I saw my little girl calm and cooperative during the examination.
A special thanks also to Cinzia at the reception desk, who already addressed all my concerns with empathy over the phone, demonstrating rare kindness and helpfulness.
In a time of anxiety, finding such compassionate people truly makes a difference. We'll be back in 14 days to see if the treatment is starting to show the first positive signs. In the meantime, thank you.

I entrusted my senior dog to the expert hands of Dr. Rita Raffaele, an excellent surgeon, and the wonderful anesthesiologist Dr. Alberta Vicenzo, the best in the field. In addition to the great patience and empathy they showed us during the weeks of pre-operative preparation, they stood out for their professionalism in performing the surgery (extraction of several teeth, including two carnassial teeth). This has proven effective because it has restored my dog's well-being, which seems to have regained a piece of her lost youth. A heartfelt thank you to the entire staff; we made the right choice, and this fills our hearts with joy and confidence in this field.
I found the answers I was looking for to my dog's pathology, very helpful and competent staff

An excellent experience at the La Terza Clinic, with attentive and caring staff. We were treated by Dr. Sgambato and Dr. Diano, who dedicated themselves to caring for our Maltese during a challenging medical situation.
The kind of humanity that distinguishes the staff is hard to find elsewhere.
very competent medical staff, Dr. Marzochella in particular is endowed with professional skills and humanity that are unparalleled

Anicura veterinary clinic is truly cutting-edge. Specifically, Dr. Italo Sgambato, a neurologist, is highly competent but, above all, very human. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for help.
I went to the emergency room with my dog ​​on Sunday. Dr. Alberta was really kind and prompt in welcoming me and taking care of my dog. Thank you so much.

Thanks to the humanity and professionalism of Dr. Sgulo, who took my cat's delicate condition to heart, I was able to get an appointment in record time with Dr. Crispino, a veterinary oncologist. He provided extensive explanations and was very empathetic and confident in handling Alex, who is truly unapproachable when he's agitated. I also thank the doctor's assistant, whom I don't know yet, who won my tiger's trust. My cat's health remains extremely fragile, but coming to this clinic made me feel relieved and listened to. The conversation with Dr. Sgulo and Dr. Crispino eased my psychological burden. It's essential to have someone to talk to when facing such a difficult diagnosis.
Thank you with all my heart.

Unfortunately, this year I have been coming to this very famous clinic in Campania for 26 years. First with the mastiffs and now with the cats, we grew up together, a part of me is always tied to them.

A special thanks goes to ultrasound specialist Dr. Zarelli and Dr. Marzocco, who assisted and cared for my cat, Sharif. I can only leave an extremely positive review for the Anicur clinic in Laterza (Naples). My dachshund underwent delicate spinal surgery, and from the very first moment we were treated with truly extraordinary professionalism and care.

The staff proved to be competent, compassionate, and always available to clarify any questions, accompanying us step by step through a very difficult time for us. The surgery was a complete success, and my dog ​​is recovering wonderfully, a feat I owe entirely to the skill of the doctors and the quality of care received.

A special thank you for the sensitivity and passion they put into their work: you can truly sense how much they care about animals and their well-being.

I recommend this facility to anyone needing high-quality veterinary care. For us, they were simply exceptional!
Professional receptionists, Ms. Cinzia, are always available both by phone and in person, and appointments are always punctual.

I recently visited the veterinary emergency room on a Sunday and I want to sincerely thank all the staff for their professionalism and helpfulness. Since Sunday service was added, I feel much more at ease, knowing that if we need help, there's someone ready to help our animals, even in the most difficult times.

I was cared for carefully, and everything was explained clearly, making me feel at ease during a time of great concern. I can tell they work with great commitment and dedication, even under pressure.

Furthermore, since it's an extraordinary service, it's absolutely normal for it to cost more, but the peace of mind of having assistance even on Sundays is truly worth it.

A sincere thank you to all the staff for their work every day. It's reassuring to know that there are such competent and helpful people ready to help when needed.

The clinic is a point of reference for me; it's rare to find doctors (and especially people) with their empathy. I'm happy to trust them, because they understand my concerns when one of my cats has something wrong. I've always found attention and compassion for my little ones. Dr. Marzocchella, who treats me, is always ready to help, even with just a word of comfort (which is not a given). But I must say that with all the doctors I've spoken to, I've always found kindness and attention. ❤️ My little ones aren't very happy to go there, but all in all, they always get cuddles. Thanks from Matisse, Margot, Loki, and Tully
Dr. AMBROSINO TOP

Dr. Pollina saved my dog. My 5-year-old dog had started shaking a few months ago (the symptoms appeared in November 2025, to be precise). I initially thought it was cold, then anxiety, and finally some neurological issue. The latter hypothesis became increasingly likely, as over the days other symptoms were added to the shaking, such as weakness in her lower legs, sharp nocturnal tremors, dizziness, lethargy, increased urination, and increased thirst.
On the advice of my trusted veterinarian, last month I booked an appointment at the Laterza clinic with Dr. Gilberto Pollina, a veterinary neurologist she knows.
During the visit, which was thorough and in-depth, Dr. Pollina also checked the blood tests my dog ​​had had a few months earlier (December 2025), and after carefully reading them, he noticed a lower-than-normal electrolyte (sodium/potassium) level. So her suspicion immediately fell on Addison's disease, a rare autoimmune disease that affects adult dogs. Dr. Pollina therefore advised us to investigate further and have my trusted veterinarian perform an endogenous ACTH test to confirm the diagnosis. After this test, her suspicion was confirmed, and my dog ​​began treatment (which is lifelong for this disease), and within a month of starting it, she was back to being the dog I knew.
I will never be able to thank Dr. Pollina enough; he saved my dog's life, as it is very difficult to diagnose this disease quickly given its very vague symptoms, which can easily be confused with those of other diseases. Thank you, thank you, thank you.
High-caliber and kind staff and doctors

Exceptional clinic and highly qualified staff! My dog ​​is dealing with a serious parology, which hadn't yet been properly diagnosed. I went by appointment, had all the necessary and specific tests done within the indicated timeframe, and the next day I had all the detailed results, which allowed me to immediately begin the required treatment. Highly recommended.

An extremely well-organized clinic, the only thing that sets it apart from a hospital is the presence of four-legged patients. The Sunday and night emergency service is important.

A special thanks to Dr. R. De Santo, who cared for my dog ​​with great love, expertise, and professionalism.
